params.name: organizationId
params.description: The numeric ID of the Brella organization.

params.name: page[size]
params.description: Number of records per page. Maximum 500. Pagination is mandatory.

params.name: page[number]
params.description: The page number to retrieve. Pagination is mandatory.

params.name: created_from
params.description: Return events created on or after this ISO 8601 timestamp.

params.name: created_to
params.description: Return events created on or before this ISO 8601 timestamp.

items.docs: List the events belonging to a Brella organization. Supports mandatory pagination and optional ISO 8601 date-range filtering.
